changelog:
- Initial release of the Huawei Cloud Skill Tester.
- Implements an end-to-end, three-tier, eight-phase functional testing pipeline for Huawei Cloud skills.
- Supports single-skill unit tests, multi-skill orchestration, and consolidated full-flow reports.
- Standardizes JSON output and requires real-environment resource execution.
- Adds chain verification, agent-proof user confirmation, sibling skill auto-scan, and batch testing support.
- CLI and SDK test modes supported; all phases provide unified, repeatable output and result reporting.
summary: End-to-end functional testing framework for Huawei Cloud skills — three-tier pipeline covering single-skill unit testing, multi-skill orchestration, and end-to-end full flow testing. Each phase produces structured JSON output with chain verification. Supports skill installation validation, functional analysis, CLI→SDK→API feasibility research, test case generation, real-environment execution with resource lifecycle, resource cleanup, multi-skill scenario orchestration, trigger-conflict detection, and consolidated reporting. Triggers include: 测试技能, 执行技能测试, 跑测试流程, 技能回归测试, skill test, run skill tests, test huawei cloud skill, verify skill, 测试华为云skill, 全流程测试, 编排测试, 技能完整性检查, skill-tester, 跑测试, 回归测试, 组合测试, 多skill编排, verification, e2e.
